content: Amurǝma mǝnana amǝ Isǝrayila lia a munǝo ka

Amǝnia ka à nda ka amurǝma mala nzali a takuli mala Jodan, mǝnana amǝ Isǝrayila lia a lwa sǝ à ak nzali malea arǝia, tite a Ɓangŋaban mala Arnon sǝ sarǝa aban ká a Nkono Hamon, andǝ Araba kat nǝ njartakuli ka:

Sihon murǝm mala amǝ'Amor mǝnana do a Heshbon sǝ domurǝm male twal a Aruwa mǝnana nda a nzong Ɓangŋaban Arnon, sǝ twal a tsùrú mala ɓangŋabanì aban ká Nggeasala Jabok, yì nzong-nzali mala amǝ'Amon; mǝnana nda gauwa-tsùrú mala Gilǝyat ka;
andǝ Araba aban ká Nggeamùr Chineret, nǝ takuli, sǝ aban ká Nggeamùr mala Araba, yì Nggeamùr Tuɓamur, nǝ njartakuli, njar ká a Bet-Jeshimot; sǝ nǝ njar-kunmur aban ká ɓunnoban a kusǝ Nkono Pisga;
andǝ Og, murǝm Bashan, mǝnana nda mwashat aɓalǝ acili amǝ'Refa mǝnana à do a Ashtarot andǝ Edǝri,

sǝ duk-murǝm a bù-nzali mǝnana lo a Nkono Hamon aban ká a Saleka, sǝ a Bashan kat aban ká a nzong-nzali mala amǝ'Geshur andǝ mala amǝ'Ma'aka ka, andǝ gauwa-tsùrú mala Gilǝyat, yì nzong-nzali mala Sihon murǝm mala Heshbon.
Musa, guro mala Yahweh, andǝ amǝ Isǝrayila gandǝia. Sǝ Musa, guro mala Yahweh pè amǝ'tàu mala Ruben, andǝ amǝ'tàu mala Gad, andǝ gauwa-tsùrú mala amǝ'tàu mala Manasa ɓǝ̀ duk girkuma malea.
Amurǝma mǝnana Jesǝwa gandǝia ka

Amǝnia ka à nda ka amurǝma mala nzali mǝnana Jesǝwa andǝ amǝ Isǝrayila gandǝia a nkaring Jodan, nǝ njar-nzali, twal a Ba'al-Gad aɓa ɓangŋaban Lebano aban ká Nkono Halak, a njar-kúnmur mǝnana tù aban Seyir ka. Jesǝwa pè atau mala amǝ Isǝrayila nzali mǝnia ka ɓǝ̀ duk girkuma malea arǝ anggǝsan malea,

aɓa nzali múr-ankono, aɓa dulum, aɓa Araba, aɓa ɓunnoban, aɓa pǝɗanban, sǝ aɓa Negev. Nzali mǝnia ɗiɗyal ka nda nzali-do mala amǝ'Hitti, andǝ amǝ'Amor, andǝ amǝ'Kan'ana, andǝ amǝ'Periz, andǝ amǝ'Hivi, sǝ amǝ'Jebus:
murǝm mala Jeriko, mwashat; murǝm mala Ai, mǝnana a nkanggari Betel ka, mwashat;
murǝm mala Urǝshalima, mwashat; murǝm mala Hebǝron, mwashat;
murǝm mala Jarmut mwashat; murǝm mala Lakish, mwashat;
murǝm mala Egǝlon, mwashat; murǝm mala Geza, mwashat;
murǝm mala Debir, mwashat; murǝm mala Geda mwashat;
murǝm mala Horma, mwashat; murǝm mala Arat, mwashat;
murǝm mala Libna, mwashat; murǝm mala Adulam, mwashat;
murǝm mala Makkeda, mwashat; murǝm mala Betel, mwashat;
murǝm mala Tapuwa, mwashat; murǝm mala Hefa, mwashat;
murǝm mala Afek, mwashat; murǝm mala Lasharon, mwashat;
murǝm mala Madon, mwashat; murǝm mala Hazo, mwashat;
murǝm mala Shimron-Meron, mwashat; murǝm mala Akshaf, mwashat;
murǝm mala Ta'anak, mwashat; murǝm mala Megido, mwashat;
murǝm mala Kadesh, mwashat; murǝm mala Jokneyam a Kamel, mwashat;
murǝm mala Dor a mgbangban mala Dor, mwashat; murǝm mala Goyim a Gilgal, mwashat;
sǝ murǝm mala Tǝrza, mwashat; Amurǝmanì kat ka, à nda lumi-tàrú-nong-mwashat.
